name: Sproutcycled Glass Germinator | The Complete Sprouting Kit – 500 ml
shortStory: The Sproutcycled Glass Germinator transforms reclaimed glass into a functional kitchen essential, making it easy to grow fresh sprouts at home. Designed for sprouting a variety of beans, legumes and seeds, this thoughtfully crafted kit helps you incorporate homegrown goodness into your everyday meals.

sections.title: Product Features
sections.content:
• Material: Upcycled wine bottle glass and PLA bioplastic components
• Capacity: 500 ml
• Components: Glass tumbler, bioplastic lid stand and bioplastic grid
• Usage: Home sprouting of beans, legumes and seeds
• Reusable: Designed for repeated use
• Design: Angled drainage system to support airflow and help prevent waterlogging
• Net Weight: 415 g
• Dimensions: 9.5 × 9.5 × 22 cm
• Shipping: Dispatched within 2–3 working days

sections.title: Growing Guide
sections.content:
• Step 1: Prepare the Seeds — Add 2–3 tablespoons of beans, legumes or seeds to the tumbler and rinse thoroughly.
• Step 2: Soak the Seeds — Fill the tumbler halfway with drinking water and soak for approximately 8 hours in summer or 10 hours in winter. Drain the water completely, rinse and swirl gently.
• Step 3: Begin Sprouting — Place the tumbler upside down at an angle on the lid stand, allowing excess water to drain and air to circulate.
• Step 4: Rinse and Monitor — Rinse, swirl and drain 2–3 times daily. Keep the seeds moist while ensuring they are never waterlogged.
• Step 5: Harvest and Store — Once sprouted, rinse thoroughly and drain well. Refrigerate in a clean, airtight container and consume within 5 days, provided the sprouts remain fresh. Suitable for sprouting a variety of beans, legumes and seeds, including green gram (moong), chickpeas and alfalfa seeds.

sections.title: Care Instructions
sections.content:
• Upcycled Glass Tumbler: Dishwasher safe with a gentle detergent. Handle with care.
• Bioplastic Lid & Grid: Handwash using mild dishwashing liquid and a soft scrubber. Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct heat and high temperatures.
• Drying: Allow all components to air-dry completely before storing.
• Avoid: Harsh chemicals, abrasive scrubbers and excessive heat to maintain the quality and durability of the components.
• Handcrafted Uniqueness: Each tumbler is handcrafted from reclaimed glass bottles, so slight variations in shape, colour and finish are natural and add to its uniqueness. The shade of green may vary depending on bottle availability.
